part.text:
Book tracker ready at `http://localhost:3000` (`PORT` configurable, persisted to `data/books.json` + `books.json`).

- `GET /` — Currently Reading / Finished, add-book form
- `POST /books` — add (form or JSON)
- `POST /books/:id/finish` — mark finished
- `GET /books/:id` — detail with title/author/notes + shareable link
- `GET /api/books` & `/api/books/:id` — JSON API

Run with `npm start`.
